atoms.title: Firewall types (stateful vs. stateless)
atoms.objective: Distinguish stateless from stateful firewalls, explain how each inspects traffic, and identify which type is better suited to a given threat scenario.

atoms.title: Firewall rules and access control lists (ACLs)
atoms.objective: Write and evaluate an ordered firewall access control list (ACL), correctly apply first-match-wins evaluation, and identify when a rule's placement creates a security gap by shadowing a more specific rule below it.
